title: R0_QUESTIONNAIRE — X-rays (pseudonymised)
description: Minimally processed pseudonymised metadata (TCode instead of StudyID, shifted dates, PII removed, letter codes as numbers) from xrays.json containing Chest X-rays by age range, special X-ray examinations, radiation treatments to the chest or neck, and the details of each examination or treatment, collected at baseline.

R0_ChestLungXray.description: Whether the participant has ever had a chest or lung X-ray.
R0_ChestLungXray.$comment: Source coding: 0 More than one option chosen; 1 Yes; 2 No.

default: S02:p.30 Q9:1 Have you ever had an X-ray to your chest or lungs (such as for asthma, or tuberculosis, or for a hospital admission or routine examination)? Yes No

ChestXrayEvents.title: Number of chest X-rays by age range
ChestXrayEvents.description: The number of plain chest X-rays in each age range (under 20, 20-39, 40-59, 60 and older). A range the participant has not reached or left blank carries -999.

XrayEvents.title: X-ray examinations and radiation treatments
XrayEvents.description: One entry per X-ray examination or radiation treatment reported under 9:2 and 9:3, up to 12, in the order reported. The first three are printed on pages 31 and 32; further ones go on page 15:1 and are flagged by R0_XrayMoreEvents, and more than twelve by R0_XrayMoreThanTwelve.

default: S02:p.31 Q9:4 please fill in details here of these x-ray examinations or treatments

XrayEvents.x-universe: Only completed when the participant answered Yes to at least one of the X-ray examinations or treatments in 9:2 and 9:3; 9:4 says 'If you answered yes to any of the questions in 9:2 or 9:3, please fill in details here'.

R0_Xray_Num.title: Which examination or treatment this entry refers to (1st, 2nd, ...)

allOf.$comment: Skip pattern R053: the participant did not answer Yes to ever having had an X-ray to the chest or lungs (0 or 2), so the numbers of chest X-rays are structurally not applicable -- every age range of ChestXrayEvents keeps its place and carries the missing-numeric sentinel. Questionnaire p.30 Q9:1: 'If yes, please state below the number of chest X-rays you have had'.

default: S02:p.30 Q9:1 If yes, please state below the number of chest X-rays you have had

allOf.$comment: Skip pattern R054: the participant did not answer Yes to any of the thirteen X-ray examinations and treatments of 9:2 and 9:3 (every answer 0 or 2), so the details of 9:4 are not asked -- XrayEvents is empty and R0_XrayMoreEvents carries the missing-numeric sentinel. Questionnaire p.31 Q9:2 and Q9:4: 'If you answer yes to any of these, please fill in the details in question 9:4'.

default: S02:p.31 Q9:4 If you answered yes to any of the questions in 9:2 or 9:3, please fill in details here
